verdict: green narrow design; implementation and performance verification pending

candidate.interpretation: Avoids Source/Path reconstruction for dead checkpoint eligibility decisions. Local instrumented profile is not production CPU attribution or acceptance.

correctness_proof: Previous digest match returns only after budget admission, temporal refresh, and manifest.verify; checkpoint eligibility is never used on that branch.
When cache_prepared is false the old heuristic could only assign false again.
On a miss with cache_prepared true the identical strict average-size predicate must run before checkpoint session/reduction.
No source changes needed in Manifest, generation digest, readers, service freshness/admission/progress, codec, or trading.
regression_obligations: No heuristic manifest.files expansion on verified previous digest, with enabled and disabled checkpoint stores.
No heuristic expansion when prepare is false; cold/miss path still reads and validates every canonical selected row.
Strict threshold: average below 16384 disables checkpoints; equality and above allow eligibility; empty set remains safe.
Mixed sizes use total size divided by selected file count equivalently, not per-file cutoff.
Changed file, replacement/inode, same-size rewrite/mtime, member add/remove, and post-discovery concurrent mutation cannot publish cached complete data.
Proposal temporal window refresh at exact cutoff remains inclusive and clock reversal remains failure.
Small-proposal canonical behavior and large-proposal checkpoint parity stay identical.
Input hashes unchanged; exact full outputs and coverage same at fixed evaluation time; 20 paired uninstrumented trials before claims.

cpu_attribution.interpretation: Pre-cycle baseline during four-session load, not idle. /proc dashboard and engine counters exclude child and remote observer CPU.
cpu_attribution.observer_guest_work: Separate remote Python process reads two PID status/stat and /proc/meminfo each second; every 15 seconds selects activity shard and parses at most 262144 bytes. Its own CPU was not retained. Local WebSocket/protobuf observer CPU is outside Fly guest.
cpu_attribution.watcher_evidence: All 352 complete requests reported zero watchers; each 4 guard-aborted request max one watcher. No rerender storm observed, no function-level failure causality proven.
